Our story

From Our Fields To Your Formula

Every spring, our tulip fields bloom, and every year the bulbs that grow them would once have been discarded. Bloomeffects was the first to upcycle tulips, bulb to bloom, and ask what the flower could do for skin.

The answer became the Proprietary Tulip Complex. Tulips carry science-backed regenerative properties: they strengthen the skin barrier, hydrate and plump, provide antioxidant protection, and brighten. It is the complex at the heart of every formula we make.

We call it consciously clinical. Science meets nature, with intention about what touches your skin and the planet: thoughtfully sourced ingredients, sustainably packaged products, and transparency in every formula, tested for the safety of your skin and the earth.
